Quoted commas now import correctly: `"Müller, Hans"` stays in one cell, so the columns no longer shift. The full suite passes (80/80).

**Cause:** `parseLegacyCsv` in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts` uses `line.split(',')`, which ignores quotes.

**Fix:**
- I didn't touch `src/legacy/`, because the Monday sync overwrites that folder. Instead I added `src/lib/csv.ts` with a quote-aware parser, `parseImportCsv`.
- It handles quoted commas, escaped quotes (`""`), newlines inside quotes, CRLF line endings and a leading BOM.
- It returns the same row shape as the legacy parser and still uses the legacy `mapLegacyCarrier`, so carrier mapping is unchanged.
- `src/routes/import.ts` now calls `parseImportCsv`.

**Tests:** the new `test/csv-quotes.test.ts` covers the parser and a `POST /import` with `"Müller, Hans"`. The existing `parseLegacyCsv` test in `test/import.test.ts` is unchanged and still passes.

**Behavior change:** line numbers in import errors now count CSV records, not raw text lines. A quoted newline inside a field no longer shifts the numbering. Plain files give the same numbers as before.

The legacy parser still has the bug, so anything else that calls it will hit it too. Only the import route was using it.

I haven't added anything to `.gemkeeper/ledger.md` yet. If you want, I'll note that `/import` now uses `src/lib/csv.ts` because `src/legacy/` can't be edited.

# Ledger — parcel-tracker

## Goal
Work on parcel-tracker (Node 24 runs TS directly, no build step, zero deps). User reviews everything at the end; work autonomously.

## Hard rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites the folder every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- (user) NO new npm dependencies, not even dev deps — each new package needs security review (~6 weeks).

## Decisions
(none yet)

## Dead ends
(none yet)

## State / next step
Read package.json, README, app.ts, store.ts, routes/shipments.ts, services/eta.ts; summary delivered. Awaiting tasks.

## Update: holidays task done
- Decision (user): Austrian holidays hardcoded in src/services/holidays.ts (2026+2027 only) — deployment has no outbound internet, so no holiday API. Must be extended before 2028.
- eta.ts isBusinessDay now also excludes holidays; tests in test/holidays.test.ts. Suite: 46/46 pass.

## Known flaky test
- (user) 'emits webhook on delivered' in test/events.test.ts is flaky (~1 in 5 on CI, timer race in fake notifier), tracked as OPS-412, platform team owns the fix. If it fails: rerun once, do NOT try to fix.

## Tracking-number validation task
- (user) ATP tracking numbers must be valid UPU S10 incl. check digit (algorithm in docs/carriers.md). All other carriers: accept any non-empty value — formats change often; last year valid DHL numbers were rejected for 2 days, so deliberately NOT validated.
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (warehouse staff UI shows them verbatim to packers). `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
- Done: src/lib/s10.ts (check digit + German errors, code INVALID_TRACKING_NUMBER), hooked into validateShipmentInput (so /import validates ATP too); test/tracking.test.ts. Suite 55/55. Existing English messages left untouched (rule applies to NEW ones only).

## ERP signing task (done)
- notify.ts signs raw body (HMAC-SHA256 hex, X-Signature) when ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET set; config.erp.webhookSecret; test/signature.test.ts; suite 60/60. Unset secret => unsigned (sandbox/rollout ERP-1182).
- Open finding (not fixed, not asked): ErpPayload sends `type`/`at` but docs/erp-api.md wants `event_type`/`occurred_at` (`type` accepted only until 2026-12-31; `at` not listed).

## DEAD END: X-Signature header (user, verified on staging)
- ERP API gateway strips every custom X- header, so header signing never arrives (ERP rejected all as unsigned). Do NOT use headers for the signature.
- Decision (user): signature goes in the JSON body as top-level field `sig` = HMAC-SHA256 hex over the JSON body WITHOUT `sig`. Header removed.
- Done: notify.ts now appends `sig` (last key) to body, no header; tests updated; README updated; suite 61/61. Note for ERP: sig is over JSON.stringify of the payload without sig, original key order.

## ERP retries task
- (user) Retry ERP call on network error or 5xx: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30s delay, NO exponential backoff. Reason: ERP dedupes by event_id only within a 2-minute window; all attempts must land within 2 min or the ERP gets duplicate events. Delay must be injectable for tests.
- Done: notify.ts createNotifier({maxAttempts,delayMs,sleep,post}) + ErpResponseError; retries network/timeout/5xx, not 4xx; same payload each attempt; worst case 3x5s timeout + 2x30s = 75s < 2 min. notifyErp = createNotifier(). test/retry.test.ts; suite 70/70.
- Caveat: pending retries are in-memory only (lost on restart); events route calls notify fire-and-forget (`void`), so retries don't block API responses.

## DEAD END: batching ERP calls (user, tried Sept 2026)
- Do NOT batch events into array POST
